title: Allocating Recurrent Compute in Looped Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.18230v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Looped language models improve reasoning and knowledge manipulation by applying shared computation repeatedly. Existing systems usually repeat an entire layer stack, although a mixer and a dense feed-forward network (FFN) perform different operations and have different costs. We ask a narrower question: what should loop? We view recurrence as repeated composition of a state update and argue that an application is valuable when it exposes a new cross-position influence direction that remains observable at the task readout. Iterative Transport Rank (ITR) describes the cumulative influence trajectory; marginal ITR describes the nonredundant influence contributed by successive applications. This view motivates MixerLoop, which repeats each Gated DeltaNet mixer while applying its dense FFN once. We compare MixerLoop with no recurrence and full-block recurrence at 15M and 110M parameters under the same data, initialization, and architecture. A

translated_title: 循环语言模型中循环计算的分配
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18230v1 公告类型：新 摘要：循环语言模型通过重复应用共享计算来改进推理和知识操作。现有系统通常重复整个层堆栈，尽管混合器和密集前馈网络（FFN）执行不同的操作且具有不同的成本。我们提出了一个更具体的问题：什么应该循环？我们将循环视为状态更新的重复组合，并认为当应用暴露了一个新的跨位置影响方向，且该方向在任务读出时仍然可观察时，该应用是有价值的。迭代传输秩（ITR）描述了累积影响轨迹；边际ITR描述了连续应用贡献的非冗余影响。这一观点催生了MixerLoop，它重复每个Gated DeltaNet混合器，同时仅应用一次其密集FFN。我们在相同数据、初始化和架构下，将MixerLoop与无循环和全块循环在15M和110M参数下进行比较。
tldr: 本文提出MixerLoop方法，通过仅循环混合器层而非整个层堆栈，利用ITR理论优化循环计算分配，在相同条件下提升循环语言模型的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MixerLoop, which loops only mixer layers rather than the entire stack, leveraging ITR theory to optimize recurrent computation allocation and improve looped language model performance under identical conditions.
